title: Security evidence — quick daily log
content:
2026-03-12 — quick scratchpad (Laura)

Morning goals:
- finalise list of evidence items to hand to audit team (export + vetted notes)
- follow up with infra on KMS key rotation proof
- sanity-check vendor A’s attestation doc and note gaps

Top TODOs (today)
- [ ] IAM access review export: get csv from GCP IAM (who: Evan) — target by 3pm
- [ ] KMS rotation artifact: console screenshot + kms logs (who: infra eng) — chase Marco
- [x] Incident response runbook draft (local copy) — version noted in GH PR #87
- [ ] Vendor A: request SOC2 cert & evidence of subservice providers — sent email, waiting reply
- [ ] Confirm encryption-at-rest config for DB replicas — need db-admin confirmation
- [ ] Map evidence to control IDs (CC 6.1, CC 7.2 etc.) — start mapping, rough ETA 2 days

Notes on evidence storage convention (reminder to self)
- keep originals in shared drive: shared_drives/security/soc2/raw-evidence/
- vetted copies -> shared_drives/security/soc2/for-auditors/ (read-only)
- ephemeral working copies stay here (this doc) or in personal folder until finalized

Vendor A quick scan (first pass)
- attestation.pdf: ok but missing third-party subproc list
- controls matrix: out of date (2024-08) -> request updated matrix and timeline for remediation
- red flags: they use a custom SSO provider (ask for architecture diagram + IdP logs retention)

Meeting notes: 2026-03-11 sync with SRE (10:30)
- Confirmed automated export for audit logs (stackdriver -> sink to GCS weekly)
- SRE to add retention note: 13 months (SEC wants 12+ for overlap) — Evan to verify retention policy config by end of week
- Action: add sample log excerpt to evidence bundle for control CC 8.3

Blockers / risks
- Can't produce KMS key rotation proof until infra gives the rotation event IDs (lack of audit trail): escalate to Marco + Claire
- Vendor A timeline unknown — if they don’t provide cert by 03/20, need mitigation (temporary vendor risk exception + compensating controls)

Questions to resolve (short)
- Do we accept vendor attestation older than 12 months if corroborated with other artifacts? (ask legal/infosec)
- Is the service account key rotation schedule documented anywhere? I think there was a Confluence page but unsure of owner

Micro-actions (5–15m)
- ping infra channel about KMS log locations (slack)
- attach incident runbook snapshot to PR #87
- create SEC-420 ticket to track Vendor A follow-ups

Quick decision log (for audit)
- 2026-03-10: Incident runbook version 0.9 accepted for internal review (Laura)
- 2026-03-11: Retention for stackdriver logs confirmed as 13 months pending infra config (SRE)

Scratchy thoughts / to self
- Don’t over-structure this doc — keep as a live checklist until artifacts move into shared drive folder for audit prep
- Save a copy before heavy edits: file name template -> security-evidence-v1-YYYYMMDD.pdf

Next steps (tomorrow)
- start mapping evidence -> controls doc with a small table (CC id -> artifact path -> owner -> status)
- meet legal about vendor attestation acceptance policy (book 30m)

End of note.

(If I forget: follow up items pinned to slack thread: #sec-soc2-audit, search for message ts 1623456789012345)
